text:
morgan: FYI seeing a sudden spike of 502/504s from frontdoor (eu-west1) starting ~03:40 UTC. Customers reporting streaming timeouts and complete fails. trace ids: abc123def, ghi456jkl. Looks correlated with a VIP swap we did ~03:38. Example failing request attached.

jia: can you paste a curl sample + response headers? any common tenant/customer?

morgan: quick repro:
```
curl -i -v 'https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate' \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  --data '{"model":"redwood-7b","prompt":"hi","stream":true}' \n  --max-time 30
```
response: HTTP/2 502\nserver: envoy\nupstream: auth-proxy\nerror: "upstream prematurely closed connection"

sam: grabbing envoy logs now. seeing repeated ENVOY upstream reset: "recv_reset" and long tail of h2 stream stalls. spike starts 03:39:12 UTC.

ops-bot: deploy/edge-v2.1.10 -> eu-west1 scheduled at 03:00 UTC

ellie: note — we rotated auth-cache and billing-cache yesterday (03:30 UTC) to reduce memory. Could be TTL eviction pattern.

jia: ok can we confirm whether auth-proxy connection pool exhausted? also any SNI/VIP changes in LB? 

sam: checked metrics: auth-proxy conn_in_use hit 100% for ~90s; upstream queue grew. There was a brief VIP reassign event at 03:38:55 (k8s node drain + cert reload). Auth TTL evictions spiked at 03:39:05.

morgan: observed client retries from guest SDK + immediate reconnects — likely amplifying the burst. Many requests had large metadata headers which increased upstream write time.

tom: short mitigation applied at 03:45 UTC: bumped auth-proxy max connections (from 80->200), reduced envoy idle_timeout to 10s, enabled 503 fallback for the longest streams and added 2s jitter on client retry policy via frontdoor rate-limiter. Also pinned SNI routing back to previous VIP pool.

sam: after mitigation errors dropped ~90% in 6 minutes. tail latency recovered to baseline by 03:52 UTC.

ellie: adding post-mortem ticket and assigning eng-sre + auth-proxy owners. tentative root cause: VIP swap during auth-cache rotation caused transient connpool exhaustion; client retry amplification + large headers pushed upstream to early closes.

morgan: customer impact: several hosted-api customers saw streaming failures for ~10 minutes. sent initial customer notice and follow-up explanation.

jia: follow-ups: add graceful backpressure on guest SDK, limit header size for tenant metadata, add alert when conn_in_use > 70% for auth-proxy. + add a canary step for VIP swaps against active auth-cache.

sam: logging note: capture "upstream prematurely closed connection" and include tenant-id + trace in logs for quicker correlation.

ops-bot: incident-created #INC-2026-345

morgan: thanks all — will sync in eng-sre channel with timeline and remediation playbook.
